name: roberts-skills
description: Provider-agnostic agent skills for AI coding assistants — bug hunting, code review, native macOS/iOS design, and full-stack scaffolding.

plugins.name: bughunt-suite
plugins.description: Offensive whole-codebase bug hunter for any project type. Recon, then fan out parallel hunters across 9 analysis lenses × risk hotspots; merge, cross-validate, and report ranked, reproducible findings. Includes triage (severity × confidence + repro) and fuzz (property/fuzz harnesses). Report-only. Commands: /bughunt, /triage, /fuzz.

plugins.name: autoreview
plugins.description: Hard acceptance gate before marking work complete. Reviews all session changes for production quality — correctness, code quality, architecture, maintainability, security, testing, and cleanup. Command: /review.

plugins.name: scaffold
plugins.description: Product-driven greenfield Next.js: intake profiles (SaaS, internal tool, API-first), typed env, Vitest, tRPC, Neon/Drizzle, optional Clerk, Vercel. Command: /scaffold.

plugins.name: macos-sandbox
plugins.description: Smoke-test macOS .app/.pkg in disposable Tart VMs via the macbox CLI or MCP — upload, launch, logs, screenshots, crashes, guest automation. Command: /macos-sandbox.

plugins.name: macos-design
plugins.description: Design, critique, and scaffold native macOS apps — HIG, Liquid Glass, menus, toolbars, sidebars, safe areas, accessibility, SwiftUI/AppKit. Pairs with macos-notch. Command: /macos-design.

plugins.name: macos-notch
plugins.description: Design and implement macOS Dynamic Island / notch-style apps — NSPanel, hardware-aligned geometry, state machine, module widgets (media, HUD, shelf, agents). Pairs with macos-design. Command: /macos-notch.

plugins.name: web-marketing-landing
plugins.description: Design and scaffold a premium SaaS marketing home page (aurora hero, glass nav, connector hub, bento grid, CSS motion) on Next.js + Tailwind v4. Command: /landing-page.
